flyer.justification: The flyer captures the main concepts well, but the title length exceeds the 6-word maximum requirement.

linkedin.justification: Adheres strictly to all formatting rules, avoiding banned filler words while clearly communicating core talk takeaways.

instagram.justification: Follows all Instagram formatting constraints including visual carousel cues and hashtag count while staying true to the talk.

summary.justification: Well-structured executive briefing under 400 words that accurately summarizes key evidence and action items from the transcript.

newsletter.justification: Meets subject line length limits and required structural sections while maintaining a conversational editorial tone.

blog.justification: Comprehensive long-form post adhering to all Markdown formatting rules, numbered sections, takeaway matrix, and author bio.
